name: Rome
description: Rome, Italy's capital, is a sprawling, cosmopolitan city with nearly 3,000 years of globally influential art, architecture and culture on display. Ancient ruins such as the Forum and the Colosseum echo the power of the former Roman Empire.

name: Paris
description: Paris, France's capital, is a major European city and a global center for art, fashion, gastronomy and culture. Its 19th-century cityscape is crisscrossed by wide boulevards and the River Seine, and is known for the Eiffel Tower, world-class museums and romantic cafés.

name: Barcelona
description: Barcelona, the sun-soaked capital of Spain's Catalonia region, is known for its art and architecture. The fantastical Sagrada Família church and other modernist landmarks designed by Antoni Gaudí dot the city. Museu Picasso and Fundació Joan Miró exhibit modern art by their namesakes. City history museum MUHBA, includes several Roman archaeological sites.

name: Sydney
description: Sydney, capital of New South Wales and one of Australia's largest cities, is best known for its Harbourfront opera house with a sail-like design and the arched Harbour Bridge. The city is surrounded by golden beaches, national parks and vibrant neighbourhoods.

name: Dubai
description: Dubai is a city and emirate in the United Arab Emirates known for luxury shopping, ultramodern architecture and a lively nightlife scene. Burj Khalifa, an 830m-tall tower, dominates the skyscraper-filled skyline.

name: Tokyo
description: Tokyo, Japan's busy capital, mixes the ultramodern and the traditional, from neon-lit skyscrapers to historic temples. The city is famed for its towering skyscrapers, shopping districts, and some of the world's best restaurants.

name: London
description: London, the capital of England and the United Kingdom, is a 21st-century city with history stretching back to Roman times. At its heart stand the imposing Houses of Parliament, the iconic 'Big Ben' clock tower and Westminster Abbey.

name: Singapore
description: Singapore, an island city-state off southern Malaysia, is a global finance and technology hub with a tropical climate and eclectic multicultural neighbourhoods. Known for its futuristic Gardens by the Bay, Marina Bay Sands and vibrant street food.

name: Bali
description: Bali is an Indonesian island known for its forested volcanic mountains, iconic rice paddies, beaches and coral reefs. The island is home to religious sites such as Uluwatu Temple and the beach town of Kuta is a popular surfing destination.

name: New York
description: New York City comprises 5 boroughs sitting where the Hudson River meets the Atlantic Ocean. At its core is Manhattan, a densely populated borough that's among the world's major commercial, financial and cultural centers.

name: Prague
description: Prague, capital of the Czech Republic, is bisected by the Vltava River. Its heart is the medieval Old Town, with medieval astronomical clock, the Gothic Charles Bridge, Prague Castle and hundreds of spires.

name: Kyoto
description: Kyoto, on Japan's Honshu island, is a former capital and a city of a thousand shrines and temples. Its imperial palace, geisha districts and zen gardens — especially during cherry blossom season — make it a timeless destination.
